summary: Nebius Group N.V., the Nasdaq-listed AI cloud company, filed a Form 6-K on October 1, 2026, attaching a press release announcing its acquisition of Inferize, a private inference-optimization startup founded in January 2026. Inferize's technology and engineering team will join Nebius Token Factory, the managed inference platform, to cut model cold-start latency and improve GPU utilization and token economics. No purchase price, consideration mix, premium or closing timetable was disclosed, and no financial advisor or board recommendation was named. The deal adds to prior inference tuck-ins (Eigen AI, Clarifai core team). Watch for integration execution and any later disclosure of terms or earn-out structure.
